svg.text: Every route on both listeners. Generated from the source; verified 2026-11-17. Schemas on every route - no raw request.body.

Flow: client -> (Caddy / Render edge) -> family listener :3000 -> Fastify schema validation -> route handler -> Prisma -> DB. '/api/*' is auth-gated on the family listener; CORS allowlist; OPTIONS preflights pass through. Demo mode (ACCOUNT_EXPERIENCE=demo) 404s everything except the public allowlist and account-scoped routes; children (role=child) are blocked again in-handler on age-restricted routes.
No session. Served identically on both listeners.

Family listener: :3000 (households + demo). Admin listener: :3100 (loopback default, separate credential, SameSite=Strict cookie). Errors are codes (fail()), never details. All mutations are profile-scoped row checks.
